ayahs.arabicText: اِقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَ هُمْ فِیْ غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: The time of people's reckoning has drawn near, and yet they turn aside in heedlessness.

ayahs.arabicText: مَا یَاْتِیْهِمْ مِّنْ ذِكْرٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّهِمْ مُّحْدَثٍ اِلَّا اسْتَمَعُوْهُ وَ هُمْ یَلْعَبُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Whenever any fresh admonition comes to them from their Lord they barely heed it and remain immersed in play,

ayahs.arabicText: لَاهِیَةً قُلُوْبُهُمْ١ؕ وَ اَسَرُّوا النَّجْوَى١ۖۗ الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْا١ۖۗ هَلْ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ١ۚ اَفَتَاْتُوْنَ السِّحْرَ وَ اَنْتُمْ تُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: their hearts being set on other concerns. The wrong-doers whisper to one another: "This person is no more than a mortal like yourselves. Will you, then, be enchanted by sorcery while you see?"

ayahs.arabicText: قٰلَ رَبِّیْ یَعْلَمُ الْقَوْلَ فِی السَّمَآءِ وَ الْاَرْضِ١٘ وَ هُوَ السَّمِیْعُ الْعَلِیْمُ
ayahs.translation: He said: "My Lord knows well all that is spoken in the heavens and the earth. He is All-Hearing, All- Knowing."

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ قَالُوْۤا اَضْغَاثُ اَحْلَامٍۭ بَلِ افْتَرٰىهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ١ۖۚ فَلْیَاْتِنَا بِاٰیَةٍ كَمَاۤ اُرْسِلَ الْاَوَّلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They say: "Nay, these are confused dreams; nay, he has forged it; nay, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign, even as the Messengers of the past were sent with signs."

ayahs.arabicText: مَاۤ اٰمَنَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ مِّنْ قَرْیَةٍ اَهْلَكْنٰهَا١ۚ اَفَهُمْ یُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Not one township that We destroyed before them believed. Would they, then, believe?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ اِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوْحِیْۤ اِلَیْهِمْ فَسْئَلُوْۤا اَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad), even before you We never sent any other than human beings as Messengers, and to them We sent revelation. Ask the People of the Book if you do not know.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا جَعَلْنٰهُمْ جَسَدًا لَّا یَاْكُلُوْنَ الطَّعَامَ وَ مَا كَانُوْا خٰلِدِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: We did not endow the Messengers with bodies that would need no food; nor were they immortals.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنٰهُمُ الْوَعْدَ فَاَنْجَیْنٰهُمْ وَ مَنْ نَّشَآءُ وَ اَهْلَكْنَا الْمُسْرِفِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then We fulfilled the promise We had made to them: We rescued them and those whom We wished, and We destroyed those who exceeded all bounds.

ayahs.arabicText: لَقَدْ اَنْزَلْنَاۤ اِلَیْكُمْ كِتٰبًا فِیْهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ١ؕ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: We have bestowed upon you a Book that mentions you. Do you not understand?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِنْ قَرْیَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَّ اَنْشَاْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا اٰخَرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: How many a wrong-doing town did We shatter and then raise up another people.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّاۤ اَحَسُّوْا بَاْسَنَاۤ اِذَا هُمْ مِّنْهَا یَرْكُضُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Then, when they perceived Our chastisement they took to their heels and fled.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا تَرْكُضُوْا وَ ارْجِعُوْۤا اِلٰى مَاۤ اُتْرِفْتُمْ فِیْهِ وَ مَسٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْئَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (They were told): "Flee not, but return to your comforts and to your dwellings. You are likely to be questioned."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا یٰوَیْلَنَاۤ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said: "Woe to us; surely we were wrong-doers."

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَا زَالَتْ تِّلْكَ دَعْوٰىهُمْ حَتّٰى جَعَلْنٰهُمْ حَصِیْدًا خٰمِدِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They did not cease to cry this until We reduced them to stubble, still and silent.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَآءَ وَ الْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا لٰعِبِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: We did not create in sport the heavens and the earth and all that lies between the two.

ayahs.arabicText: لَوْ اَرَدْنَاۤ اَنْ نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَّاتَّخَذْنٰهُ مِنْ لَّدُنَّاۤ١ۖۗ اِنْ كُنَّا فٰعِلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Had it been Our will to find a pastime, We would have found one near at hand; if at all We were inclined to do so.

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِالْحَقِّ عَلَى الْبَاطِلِ فَیَدْمَغُهٗ فَاِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ١ؕ وَ لَكُمُ الْوَیْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Nay, We hurl the Truth at falsehood so that the Truth crushes falsehood, and lo! it vanishes. Woe to you for what you utter!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَهٗ مَنْ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ١ؕ وَ مَنْ عِنْدَهٗ لَا یَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهٖ وَ لَا یَسْتَحْسِرُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: To Him belongs whosoever dwells in the heavens and on earth. Those (angels) that are with Him neither disdain to serve Him out of pride, nor do they weary of it.

ayahs.arabicText: یُسَبِّحُوْنَ الَّیْلَ وَ النَّهَارَ لَا یَفْتُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They glorify Him night and day, without flagging.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوْۤا اٰلِهَةً مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ هُمْ یُنْشِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Have they taken earthly gods who are such that they raise up the dead to life?

ayahs.arabicText: لَوْ كَانَ فِیْهِمَاۤ اٰلِهَةٌ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ لَفَسَدَتَا١ۚ فَسُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا یَصِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Had there been any gods in the heavens and the earth apart from Allah, the order of both the heavens and the earth would have gone to ruins. Glory be to Allah, the Lord of the Throne, Who is far above their false descriptions of Him.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا یُسْئَلُ عَمَّا یَفْعَلُ وَ هُمْ یُسْئَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: None shall question Him about what He does, but they shall be questioned.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖۤ اٰلِهَةً١ؕ قُلْ هَاتُوْا بُرْهَانَكُمْ١ۚ هٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَنْ مَّعِیَ وَ ذِكْرُ مَنْ قَبْلِیْ١ؕ بَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا یَعْلَمُوْنَ١ۙ الْحَقَّ فَهُمْ مُّعْرِضُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Have they taken gods other than Him? Say, (O Muhammad): "Bring forth your proof! Here is the Book with admonition for those of my time and there are also scriptures with admonition for people before me." But most people do not know the Truth, and have, therefore, turned away from it.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْ رَّسُوْلٍ اِلَّا نُوْحِیْۤ اِلَیْهِ اَنَّهٗ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنَا فَاعْبُدُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: Never did We send any Messenger before you to whom We did not reveal: "There is no god but Me. So serve Me alone."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَلَدًا سُبْحٰنَهٗ١ؕ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: They say: "The Most Compassionate Lord has taken to Himself a son." Glory be to Him! Those whom they so designate are only His honoured servants.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا یَسْبِقُوْنَهٗ بِالْقَوْلِ وَ هُمْ بِاَمْرِهٖ یَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They do not outstrip Him in speech and only act as He commands.

ayahs.arabicText: یَعْلَمُ مَا بَیْنَ اَیْدِیْهِمْ وَ مَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَ لَا یَشْفَعُوْنَ١ۙ اِلَّا لِمَنِ ارْتَضٰى وَ هُمْ مِّنْ خَشْیَتِهٖ مُشْفِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He knows whatever is before them and whatsoever is remote from them and they do not intercede except for him, intercession on whose behalf pleases Him, and they stand constantly in awe of Him.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ یَّقُلْ مِنْهُمْ اِنِّیْۤ اِلٰهٌ مِّنْ دُوْنِهٖ فَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِیْهِ جَهَنَّمَ١ؕ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِی الظّٰلِمِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And if anyone of them were to claim: "Indeed I am a god apart from Him," We shall recompense both with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrong-doers.

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَرَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اَنَّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنٰهُمَا١ؕ وَ جَعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَیْءٍ حَیٍّ١ؕ اَفَلَا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Did the unbelievers (who do not accept the teaching of the Prophet) not realize that the heavens and the earth were one solid mass, then We tore them apart, and We made every living being out of water? Will they, then, not believe (that We created all this)?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَعَلْنَا فِی الْاَرْضِ رَوَاسِیَ اَنْ تَمِیْدَ بِهِمْ١۪ وَ جَعَلْنَا فِیْهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمْ یَهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We placed firm mountains on earth lest it should sway with them, and We made wide paths in them that they may find their way;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَعَلْنَا السَّمَآءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوْظًا١ۖۚ وَّ هُمْ عَنْ اٰیٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: and We made the sky a secure canopy; and yet they turn away from these Signs.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ خَلَقَ الَّیْلَ وَ النَّهَارَ وَ الشَّمْسَ وَ الْقَمَرَ١ؕ كُلٌّ فِیْ فَلَكٍ یَّسْبَحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It is He Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. Each of them is floating in its orbit.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ الْخُلْدَ١ؕ اَفَاۡئِنْ مِّتَّ فَهُمُ الْخٰلِدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad), We did not grant everlasting life to any human being even before you. If you were to die, will they live for ever?

ayahs.arabicText: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ١ؕ وَ نَبْلُوْكُمْ بِالشَّرِّ وَ الْخَیْرِ فِتْنَةً١ؕ وَ اِلَیْنَا تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Every living being shall taste death and We shall subject you to ill and good by way of trial, and to Us shall all of you be eventually sent back.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا رَاٰكَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اِنْ یَّتَّخِذُوْنَكَ اِلَّا هُزُوًا١ؕ اَهٰذَا الَّذِیْ یَذْكُرُ اٰلِهَتَكُمْ١ۚ وَ هُمْ بِذِكْرِ الرَّحْمٰنِ هُمْ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: When the unbelievers see you they make you an object of fun, saying: "Is he the one who mentions your gods?" They say so, and yet they reject with disdain the very mention of the Most Compassionate Lord.

ayahs.arabicText: خُلِقَ الْاِنْسَانُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ١ؕ سَاُورِیْكُمْ اٰیٰتِیْ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: Man is hasty by nature. I shall certainly show you My Signs. Do not ask Me to be hasty.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They say: "(Tell us) when will the threat of punishment come to pass if you are truthful?"

ayahs.arabicText: لَوْ یَعْلَمُ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا حِیْنَ لَا یَكُفُّوْنَ عَنْ وُّجُوْهِهِمُ النَّارَ وَ لَا عَنْ ظُهُوْرِهِمْ وَ لَا هُمْ یُنْصَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: If only the unbelievers knew of the Hour when they shall not be able to keep off the Fire from their faces, nor from their backs; nor shall they be helped.

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ تَاْتِیْهِمْ بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا یَسْتَطِیْعُوْنَ رَدَّهَا وَ لَا هُمْ یُنْظَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: That will suddenly come upon them and stupefy them. They shall not be able to ward it off, nor shall they be granted any respite.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدِ اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِالَّذِیْنَ سَخِرُوْا مِنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ یَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Other Messengers before you were also mocked, but those who scoffed at the Messengers were overtaken by the same scourge that they had scoffed at.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ مَنْ یَّكْلَؤُكُمْ بِالَّیْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ مِنَ الرَّحْمٰنِ١ؕ بَلْ هُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِمْ مُّعْرِضُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Tell them, (O Muhammad): "Who protects you, during the night or the day from the Most Compassionate Lord?" And yet they turn away from the Admonition of their Lord.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ لَهُمْ اٰلِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِنَا١ؕ لَا یَسْتَطِیْعُوْنَ نَصْرَ اَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ لَا هُمْ مِّنَّا یُصْحَبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do they have any gods who would protect them against Us? They have no power even to help themselves; nor do they enjoy Our support.

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هٰۤؤُلَآءِ وَ اٰبَآءَهُمْ حَتّٰى طَالَ عَلَیْهِمُ الْعُمُرُ١ؕ اَفَلَا یَرَوْنَ اَنَّا نَاْتِی الْاَرْضَ نَنْقُصُهَا مِنْ اَطْرَافِهَا١ؕ اَفَهُمُ الْغٰلِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Nay, We generously provided them and their fathers, and they enjoyed Our provision for long. Do they not see that We are now advancing into their territory, diminishing it from different sides? Is it they, then, who will triumph?"

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اِنَّمَاۤ اُنْذِرُكُمْ بِالْوَحْیِ١ۖ٘ وَ لَا یَسْمَعُ الصُّمُّ الدُّعَآءَ اِذَا مَا یُنْذَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Tell them: "I only warn you by the Revelation." But the deaf do not hear the cry when they are warned.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَئِنْ مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَیَقُوْلُنَّ یٰوَیْلَنَاۤ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Were only the slightest whiff from your Lord's punishment to touch them, they would cry out: "Woe to us; we were indeed wrong-doers."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نَضَعُ الْمَوَازِیْنَ الْقِسْطَ لِیَوْمِ الْقِیٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَیْئًا١ؕ وَ اِنْ كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ اَتَیْنَا بِهَا١ؕ وَ كَفٰى بِنَا حٰسِبِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: We shall set up just scales on the Day of Resurrection so that none will be wronged in the least. (We shall bring forth the acts of everyone), even if it be the weight of a grain of mustard seed. We shall suffice as Reckoners.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوْسٰى وَ هٰرُوْنَ الْفُرْقَانَ وَ ضِیَآءً وَّ ذِكْرًا لِّلْمُتَّقِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Surely We had granted to Moses and Aaron the Criterion (between right and wrong), and Light and Admonition for the good of the God-fearing,

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْنَ یَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَیْبِ وَ هُمْ مِّنَ السَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: for those who fear their Lord without seeing Him and dread the Hour (of Reckoning).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبٰرَكٌ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ١ؕ اَفَاَنْتُمْ لَهٗ مُنْكِرُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: This is a Blessed Admonition that We have revealed. Are you, then, going to reject it?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَاۤ اِبْرٰهِیْمَ رُشْدَهٗ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَ كُنَّا بِهٖ عٰلِمِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Surely We had bestowed wisdom upon Abraham even earlier, and We knew him well.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ قَالَ لِاَبِیْهِ وَ قَوْمِهٖ مَا هٰذِهِ التَّمَاثِیْلُ الَّتِیْۤ اَنْتُمْ لَهَا عٰكِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Recall, when he said to his father and his people: "What are these images to which you are devoutly clinging?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا وَجَدْنَاۤ اٰبَآءَنَا لَهَا عٰبِدِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They answered: "We found our fathers worshipping them."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ اَنْتُمْ وَ اٰبَآؤُكُمْ فِیْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: He said: "Certainly you and your fathers have all been in manifest error."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا اَجِئْتَنَا بِالْحَقِّ اَمْ اَنْتَ مِنَ اللّٰعِبِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said: "Are you expressing your true ideas before us or are you jesting?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ بَلْ رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ الَّذِیْ فَطَرَهُنَّ١ۖ٘ وَ اَنَا عَلٰى ذٰلِكُمْ مِّنَ الشّٰهِدِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: He said: "Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth which He created and to that I bear witness before you.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تَاللّٰهِ لَاَكِیْدَنَّ اَصْنَامَكُمْ بَعْدَ اَنْ تُوَلُّوْا مُدْبِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: By Allah, I shall certainly carry out my plan against your gods after you are gone."

ayahs.arabicText: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذٰذًا اِلَّا كَبِیْرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ اِلَیْهِ یَرْجِعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then he broke them all into pieces, sparing only the supreme one among them that they may possibly return to him.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا مَنْ فَعَلَ هٰذَا بِاٰلِهَتِنَاۤ اِنَّهٗ لَمِنَ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: (When they saw the idols in this state) they said: "Who has done this to our gods? Surely he is one of the wrong-doers."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا سَمِعْنَا فَتًى یَّذْكُرُهُمْ یُقَالُ لَهٗۤ اِبْرٰهِیْمُؕ
ayahs.translation: Some of them said: "We heard a youth called Abraham speak (ill) of them."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا فَاْتُوْا بِهٖ عَلٰۤى اَعْیُنِ النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَشْهَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The others said: "Bring him, then, before the eyes of the people that they may see (what will be done to him)."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا ءَاَنْتَ فَعَلْتَ هٰذَا بِاٰلِهَتِنَا یٰۤاِبْرٰهِیْمُؕ
ayahs.translation: (On Abraham's arrival) they said: "Abraham, are you he who has done this to our gods?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهٗ١ۖۗ كَبِیْرُهُمْ هٰذَا فَسْئَلُوْهُمْ اِنْ كَانُوْا یَنْطِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He answered: "Rather it was this supreme one who has done it. So ask them, if they can speak."

ayahs.arabicText: فَرَجَعُوْۤا اِلٰۤى اَنْفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوْۤا اِنَّكُمْ اَنْتُمُ الظّٰلِمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Thereupon they turned to their (inner) selves and said (to themselves): "Surely it is you who are the wrong-doers."

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوْا عَلٰى رُءُوْسِهِمْ١ۚ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هٰۤؤُلَآءِ یَنْطِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then their minds were turned upside down, and they said: "You know well that they do not speak."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اَفَتَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا یَنْفَعُكُمْ شَیْئًا وَّ لَا یَضُرُّكُمْؕ
ayahs.translation: Abraham said: "Do you, then, worship beside Allah a thing that can neither benefit you nor hurt you?

ayahs.arabicText: اُفٍّ لَّكُمْ وَ لِمَا تَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ١ؕ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Fie upon you and upon all that you worship beside Allah. Do you have no sense?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا حَرِّقُوْهُ وَ انْصُرُوْۤا اٰلِهَتَكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ فٰعِلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said: "Burn him, and come to the support of your gods, if you are going to do anything."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْنَا یٰنَارُ كُوْنِیْ بَرْدًا وَّ سَلٰمًا عَلٰۤى اِبْرٰهِیْمَۙ
ayahs.translation: We said: "O fire, become coolness and safety for Abraham."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَرَادُوْا بِهٖ كَیْدًا فَجَعَلْنٰهُمُ الْاَخْسَرِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: They had sought to do evil to him, but We caused them to be the worst losers,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نَجَّیْنٰهُ وَ لُوْطًا اِلَى الْاَرْضِ الَّتِیْ بٰرَكْنَا فِیْهَا لِلْعٰلَمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: and We saved him and Lot and brought him to the land upon which We had bestowed Our blessings for all the people of the world.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ وَهَبْنَا لَهٗۤ اِسْحٰقَ١ؕ وَ یَعْقُوْبَ نَافِلَةً١ؕ وَ كُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صٰلِحِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We bestowed upon him Isaac and Jacob as an additional gift, making each of them righteous.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَعَلْنٰهُمْ اَئِمَّةً یَّهْدُوْنَ بِاَمْرِنَا وَ اَوْحَیْنَاۤ اِلَیْهِمْ فِعْلَ الْخَیْرٰتِ وَ اِقَامَ الصَّلٰوةِ وَ اِیْتَآءَ الزَّكٰوةِ١ۚ وَ كَانُوْا لَنَا عٰبِدِیْنَۚۙ
ayahs.translation: And We made them into leaders to guide people in accordance with Our command, and We inspired them to good works, and to establish Prayers and to give Zakah. They worshipped Us alone.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لُوْطًا اٰتَیْنٰهُ حُكْمًا وَّ عِلْمًا وَّ نَجَّیْنٰهُ مِنَ الْقَرْیَةِ الَّتِیْ كَانَتْ تَّعْمَلُ الْخَبٰٓئِثَ١ؕ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فٰسِقِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: We bestowed upon Lot sound judgement and knowledge, and We delivered him from the city that was immersed in foul deeds. They were indeed a wicked people, exceedingly disobedient.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَدْخَلْنٰهُ فِیْ رَحْمَتِنَا١ؕ اِنَّهٗ مِنَ الصّٰلِحِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Verily he was of the righteous.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نُوْحًا اِذْ نَادٰى مِنْ قَبْلُ فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهٗ فَنَجَّیْنٰهُ وَ اَهْلَهٗ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِیْمِۚ
ayahs.translation: We bestowed the same favour upon Noah. Recall, when he cried to Us before; We accepted his prayer and delivered him and his household from the great distress

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نَصَرْنٰهُ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِیْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰیٰتِنَا١ؕ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَاَغْرَقْنٰهُمْ اَجْمَعِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: and We helped him against a people who rejected Our signs as false. They were indeed an evil people and so We drowned them all.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ دَاوٗدَ وَ سُلَیْمٰنَ اِذْ یَحْكُمٰنِ فِی الْحَرْثِ اِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِیْهِ غَنَمُ الْقَوْمِ١ۚ وَ كُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شٰهِدِیْنَۗۙ
ayahs.translation: We bestowed the same favour upon David and Solomon. Recall, when they gave judgement regarding a tillage into which the sheep of some people had strayed at night, and We were witnesses to their judgement.

ayahs.arabicText: فَفَهَّمْنٰهَا سُلَیْمٰنَ١ۚ وَ كُلًّا اٰتَیْنَا حُكْمًا وَّ عِلْمًا١٘ وَّ سَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوٗدَ الْجِبَالَ یُسَبِّحْنَ وَ الطَّیْرَ١ؕ وَ كُنَّا فٰعِلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: We guided Solomon to the right verdict, and We had granted each of them judgement and knowledge. We made the mountains and the birds celebrate the praise of Allah with David. It was We Who did all this.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ عَلَّمْنٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوْسٍ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُمْ مِّنْۢ بَاْسِكُمْ١ۚ فَهَلْ اَنْتُمْ شٰكِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It was We Who taught him the art of making coats of mail for your benefit so that it may protect you from each other's violence. Do you, then, give thanks?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لِسُلَیْمٰنَ الرِّیْحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِیْ بِاَمْرِهٖۤ اِلَى الْاَرْضِ الَّتِیْ بٰرَكْنَا فِیْهَا١ؕ وَ كُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَیْءٍ عٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We subdued the strongly raging wind to Solomon which blew at his bidding towards the land We blessed. We know everything.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنَ الشَّیٰطِیْنِ مَنْ یَّغُوْصُوْنَ لَهٗ وَ یَعْمَلُوْنَ عَمَلًا دُوْنَ ذٰلِكَ١ۚ وَ كُنَّا لَهُمْ حٰفِظِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And We subdued many devils who dived (into the sea) for him and carried out other jobs besides that. We kept watch over all of them.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَیُّوْبَ اِذْ نَادٰى رَبَّهٗۤ اَنِّیْ مَسَّنِیَ الضُّرُّ وَ اَنْتَ اَرْحَمُ الرّٰحِمِیْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: We bestowed (the same wisdom, judgement and knowledge) upon Job. Recall, when he cried to his Lord: "Behold, disease has struck me and You are the Most Merciful of those that are merciful."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهٗ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهٖ مِنْ ضُرٍّ وَّ اٰتَیْنٰهُ اَهْلَهٗ وَ مِثْلَهُمْ مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِنْدِنَا وَ ذِكْرٰى لِلْعٰبِدِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: We accepted his prayer and removed the affliction from him, and We not only restored to him his family but as many more with them as a mercy from Us and as a lesson to the worshippers.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِسْمٰعِیْلَ وَ اِدْرِیْسَ وَ ذَا الْكِفْلِ١ؕ كُلٌّ مِّنَ الصّٰبِرِیْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: And (We bestowed the same favour) upon Ishmael, Idris and Dhu al-Kifl, for they were all steadfast.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَدْخَلْنٰهُمْ فِیْ رَحْمَتِنَا١ؕ اِنَّهُمْ مِّنَ الصّٰلِحِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We admitted them into Our mercy, for they were of the righteous.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ ذَا النُّوْنِ اِذْ ذَّهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا فَظَنَّ اَنْ لَّنْ نَّقْدِرَ عَلَیْهِ فَنَادٰى فِی الظُّلُمٰتِ اَنْ لَّاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْتَ سُبْحٰنَكَ١ۖۗ اِنِّیْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِیْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: And We bestowed Our favour upon Dhu al-Nun. Recall, when he went forth enraged, thinking We have no power to take him to task. Eventually he cried out in the darkness:" There is no god but You. Glory be to You! I have done wrong."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهٗ١ۙ وَ نَجَّیْنٰهُ مِنَ الْغَمِّ١ؕ وَ كَذٰلِكَ نُـْۨجِی الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Thereupon We accepted his prayer, and rescued him from grief. Thus do We rescue the believers.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ زَكَرِیَّاۤ اِذْ نَادٰى رَبَّهٗ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِیْ فَرْدًا وَّ اَنْتَ خَیْرُ الْوٰرِثِیْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: And We bestowed favour upon Zechariah, when he cried to his Lord: "Lord! Leave me not solitary (without any issue). You are the Best Inheritor."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهٗ١٘ وَ وَهَبْنَا لَهٗ یَحْیٰى وَ اَصْلَحْنَا لَهٗ زَوْجَهٗ١ؕ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا یُسٰرِعُوْنَ فِی الْخَیْرٰتِ وَ یَدْعُوْنَنَا رَغَبًا وَّ رَهَبًا١ؕ وَ كَانُوْا لَنَا خٰشِعِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: So We accepted his prayer and bestowed upon him John, and We made his wife fit (to bear a child). Verily they hastened in doing good works and called upon Us with longing and fear, and humbled themselves to Us.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّتِیْۤ اَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِیْهَا مِنْ رُّوْحِنَا وَ جَعَلْنٰهَا وَ ابْنَهَاۤ اٰیَةً لِّلْعٰلَمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And also recall the woman who guarded her chastity: We breathed into her of Our spirit, and made her and her son a Sign to the whole world.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ هٰذِهٖۤ اُمَّتُكُمْ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً١ۖ٘ وَّ اَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: Verily this community of yours is a single community, and I am your Lord; so worship Me.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تَقَطَّعُوْۤا اَمْرَهُمْ بَیْنَهُمْ١ؕ كُلٌّ اِلَیْنَا رٰجِعُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: But they tore asunder their faith into many parts. But to Us they are bound to return.

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَنْ یَّعْمَلْ مِنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَ هُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْیِهٖ١ۚ وَ اِنَّا لَهٗ كٰتِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then whosoever does righteous works, while believing, his striving will not go unappreciated. We record them all for him.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ حَرٰمٌ عَلٰى قَرْیَةٍ اَهْلَكْنٰهَاۤ اَنَّهُمْ لَا یَرْجِعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It has been ordained against every town that We ever destroyed that they shall not return (to enjoy a new lease of life)

ayahs.arabicText: حَتّٰۤى اِذَا فُتِحَتْ یَاْجُوْجُ وَ مَاْجُوْجُ وَ هُمْ مِّنْ كُلِّ حَدَبٍ یَّنْسِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: until Gog and Magog are let loose, and begin swooping from every mound,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اقْتَرَبَ الْوَعْدُ الْحَقُّ فَاِذَا هِیَ شَاخِصَةٌ اَبْصَارُ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا١ؕ یٰوَیْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِیْ غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: and the time for the fulfilment of the true promise of Allah draws near, whereupon the eyes of those who disbelieved will stare in fear, and they will say: "Woe to us, we were indeed heedless of this; nay, we were wrongdoers."

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّكُمْ وَ مَا تَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ١ؕ اَنْتُمْ لَهَا وٰرِدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (They will be told): "Verily you and the gods you worshipped beside Allah are the fuel of Hell. All of you are bound to arrive there.

ayahs.arabicText: لَوْ كَانَ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ اٰلِهَةً مَّا وَرَدُوْهَا١ؕ وَ كُلٌّ فِیْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Had these indeed been gods they would not have gone there. But (as it is), all of you shall ever abide in it."

ayahs.arabicText: لَهُمْ فِیْهَا زَفِیْرٌ وَّ هُمْ فِیْهَا لَا یَسْمَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: There they shall groan with anguish and the din and noise in Hell will not let them hear anything.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُمْ مِّنَّا الْحُسْنٰۤى١ۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: But for those whom We had decided to favour with good reward, they shall be kept far removed from Hell.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا یَسْمَعُوْنَ حَسِیْسَهَا١ۚ وَ هُمْ فِیْ مَا اشْتَهَتْ اَنْفُسُهُمْ خٰلِدُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: They shall not hear even a whisper of it, and they shall live for ever in the delights which they had desired.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا یَحْزُنُهُمُ الْفَزَعُ الْاَكْبَرُ وَ تَتَلَقّٰىهُمُ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ١ؕ هٰذَا یَوْمُكُمُ الَّذِیْ كُنْتُمْ تُوْعَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The Hour of the Great Terror shall not grieve them, and the angels shall receive them saying: "This is your Day which you had been promised."

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ نَطْوِی السَّمَآءَ كَطَیِّ السِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ١ؕ كَمَا بَدَاْنَاۤ اَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُّعِیْدُهٗ١ؕ وَعْدًا عَلَیْنَا١ؕ اِنَّا كُنَّا فٰعِلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: On that Day We shall roll up the heavens like a scroll for writing. Even as We originated the creation first so We shall repeat it. This is a promise binding on Us; and so We shall do.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِی الزَّبُوْرِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ الذِّكْرِ اَنَّ الْاَرْضَ یَرِثُهَا عِبَادِیَ الصّٰلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Surely We wrote in the Psalms, after the exhortation, that the earth shall be inherited by My righteous servants.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ فِیْ هٰذَا لَبَلٰغًا لِّقَوْمٍ عٰبِدِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Herein, surely, is a message for those devoted to worship.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَرْسَلْنٰكَ اِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعٰلَمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: We have sent you forth as nothing but mercy to people of the whole world.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اِنَّمَا یُوْحٰۤى اِلَیَّ اَنَّمَاۤ اِلٰهُكُمْ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌ١ۚ فَهَلْ اَنْتُمْ مُّسْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say: "It is revealed to me that your God is only One God. Will you, then, submit to Him?"

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ اٰذَنْتُكُمْ عَلٰى سَوَآءٍ١ؕ وَ اِنْ اَدْرِیْۤ اَقَرِیْبٌ اَمْ بَعِیْدٌ مَّا تُوْعَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: If they turn away, say to them: "I have warned you all alike; and I cannot say whether what you have been promised is near or distant.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّهٗ یَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَ یَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed He knows what you say loudly and what you hide.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنْ اَدْرِیْ لَعَلَّهٗ فِتْنَةٌ لَّكُمْ وَ مَتَاعٌ اِلٰى حِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: I think that this [reprieve] is possibly a trial for you, an opportunity to enjoy yourselves until an appointed time."

ayahs.arabicText: قٰلَ رَبِّ احْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ١ؕ وَ رَبُّنَا الرَّحْمٰنُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلٰى مَا تَصِفُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: The Messenger said: "My Lord! Judge with truth. Our Compassionate Lord alone is our support against your (blasphemous) utterances."
